AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Amud is a Jewish prayer book (siddur) and halachic times app. Operational Patterns: - Use 'getNextZman' for the next halachic time, 'getSunrise' and 'getSunset' for those times. - Use 'getHebrewDate', 'getParsha' and 'getOmerCount' for the Jewish calendar. - Use 'getCandleLighting' for the next Shabbat or Yom Tov candle lighting. Constraints: - Times are for the location saved in Amud. If a function reports no up-to-date times, ask the user to open Amud once.
